learning_outcomes.text: Provide preliminary knowledge in the main stages of technological processes for metal casting, welding, plastic deformation used in the manufacture organization.
Provide practical skills in the main stages of technological processes for metal casting, welding, plastic deformation used in the manufacture organization.

syllabus_topics: manual moulding using non-sectional pattern in two moulds
excitation and running of the welding arc
welding of initial and monolayer welds
Manual forging: open manual and machine forging of a wedge, clamp and hinge bolt
assessment_rules: Control is carried out through an oral exam. A certain practical assignment is carried out, as well as a short discussion of a theoretical issue.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
